changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant task entries and consolidated to avoid duplication. Normalized dataset names and simplified output descriptions. Kept only the evaluated NLG tasks explicitly mentioned in the experiments.

Normalized metric names to consistent capitalization. Added quality evaluation metrics (HumanEval Pass@1, GSM8K Accuracy) that assess generation correctness. Removed duplicate 'mean acceptance length' since it's equivalent to 'average acceptance length'. All metrics are explicitly used to evaluate generated outputs.
Confirmed no LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The paper only uses LLMs for generation, not for evaluating outputs. Removed placeholder 'None' entries.
Confirmed no human evaluation was conducted. The paper only uses automatic metrics. Removed placeholder 'None' entries.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on accelerating speculative sampling for large-vocabulary LLMs, not on developing new NLG evaluation methods. The NLG tasks and metrics are used to benchmark the speed improvement technique. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy in task categorization. The paper properly evaluates generation quality using standard benchmarks (HumanEval, GSM8K) alongside speed metrics.
